Per-role worker receipts verify against the store.
native_verification.read_only_boundary: Read-only roles' native events contain only Read/Glob/Grep calls; side-effect tools appear exclusively in the development job. The dev session's tool-policy.json records permission_mode from the host's own settings readback, not from a constant.

The zcode adapter changes in this chain are post-unit common prerequisites explicitly authorized by the user (d7a687c source-receipt persistence; 2d36375 mode declaration; 91255c6 review fixes: honest mode evidence, deadline enforcement, clean-tree test build, admission native gate), in the precedent of 6757231/8a06fc1/4e3fa0e/d2f4847; the supervisor, the native-request.json shape, interaction delivery and verify_source are unchanged.
